system.description:
• Drake of the Last Watch is a name everyone knows — his feats of strength and his connection to the natural world are legend across Arneyan.
  • Some barbarians don't just admire the stories; they train to fight like him, study his recorded deeds, and try to embody what he stood for.
  • Less a school, more a devotion.
  • Drake's Fury: in natural wilderness, Primeval Instincts covers every physical check, not only those in extreme circumstances. While raging in natural wilderness, you have Advantage on your rolls in Trip and Grapple contests.
  • Legend's Path: Advantage on checks to identify, track, or commune with natural creatures and environments. Being recognised as a Follower of Drake opens doors — his name carries weight everywhere.
